# Validate And Measure Mattress SEO Changes

Before and after an approved change, run focused tests, `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build`, `npm run seo:mattress:inventory`, and `npm run seo:mattress:validate-inventory`. Validate route resolution, canonical host, indexability, sitemap inclusion, duplicate URLs, credible page-level `lastmod`, and rendered internal links. Protect products, recommendation order, regional availability, affiliate destinations, disclosures, and tracked product facts unless separately approved.

Append a baseline with implementation date, URL, query cluster, direct-evidence identity, metrics, and overlapping changes to `seo-results/mattress-seo-measurement-log.md`. Set preliminary review after 14 days and reliable comparisons at 28 and 56 complete days. Approval is required before commit, push, publication, or deployment.
